episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: TOWIE stars Georgia Kousoulou and Tommy Mallet prepare for the birth of their first child, Brody, documenting their excitement, anxiety, and the life-changing experience of becoming parents, culminating in the baby's arrival and Tommy's supportive role during the birth. The episode captures their journey into parenthood, highlighting the emotional highs and lows as they embrace their new roles as a family.
